item.title: Feature Development for the Conan Build System
item.description: Contributed a feature to the Conan C/C++ package manager, part of a broader push to bring modern build tooling into avionics development.
item.content:encoded:
While evaluating Conan and CMake as a potential replacement for a legacy proprietary build toolchain at Airbus Helicopters, I ran into gaps in Conan itself — and contributed a feature back to the project rather than working around it.

This was part of a larger proof of concept where I paired Conan with CMake to demonstrate a modern, open-source alternative to an internal build pipeline, which reduced the dev/compile/flash/test workflow time by 95%.

Stack: Conan, CMake, C/C++

item.title: CMake Bug Fix Upstreamed to the Community
item.description: Found and fixed a bug in CMake, and pushed the patch upstream to the community.
item.content:encoded:
While working with CMake on embedded C/C++ projects, I ran into a bug in the tool itself. Rather than working around it locally, I tracked down the root cause, wrote a fix, and pushed the patch upstream so other users would benefit from it too.

Stack: CMake, C++
